description: Source code implementing the ConnectServerBackend class for handling QUIC connection requests, including handling CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP protocols, managing tunnels, and interfacing with a non-connect backend.

classes.name: ConnectServerBackend
classes.description: Class managing QUIC connection backend, handling CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP requests, and managing tunnels.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response with specified error code to the request handler.

methods.name: ConnectServerBackend
methods.description: Constructor initializing the backend with non-connect backend, acceptable destinations, UDP targets, and server label.

methods.name: ~ConnectServerBackend
methods.description: Destructor ensuring all tunnels are closed before destruction.

methods.name: InitializeBackend
methods.description: Initializes the backend, always returns true.

methods.name: IsBackendInitialized
methods.description: Checks if backend is initialized, always returns true.

methods.name: SetSocketFactory
methods.description: Sets the socket factory used for creating tunnels.

methods.name: FetchResponseFromBackend
methods.description: Delegates response fetching to the non-connect backend.

methods.name: HandleConnectHeaders
methods.description: Handles incoming CONNECT or CONNECT-UDP headers, establishing tunnels or delegating.

methods.name: HandleConnectData
methods.description: Processes data for established tunnels or delegates to non-connect backend.

methods.name: CloseBackendResponseStream
methods.description: Closes tunnels and delegates stream closure to non-connect backend.
